entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Provide a supported way to access dotnet.d.ts for WebAssembly SDK projects #118562
  • [browser] Allow access to asset data after `dotnet.download()` #118561

PullRequests

Created

  • Implement UnhandledException hook for finalizer scenario in Mono. #118563
    runtime-mono, linkable-framework, needs-area-label
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 139.0.7258.66, windows: 139.0.7258.67 #118559
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Merged

  • Remove unsafe code from Log2SoftwareFallback #118560
    area-System.Numerics, reduce-unsafe
  • JIT: Build community JITs on Windows in superpmi-diffs again #118437
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Updated

  • Report invalid global.json state in `dotnet --info` and `hostfxr_resolve_sdk2` #118418
    area-Host
  • Add NativeAOT on Android test #118037
    os-android, area-Infrastructure-mono, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Add `DOTNET_HOST_PATH` property when initializing for framework-dependent apps #118249
    area-Host
  • Optimize out metadata for `typeof(X).IsValueType` and `.IsEnum` #118528
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix for XSLT extension methods format-date & format-time #114200
    area-System.Xml, community-contribution, 10.0.0
  • Introduce size-optimized IListSelect iterator #118156
    area-System.Linq
